_about: Deal-size tiers: the deal ARR (USD) decides how much custom configuration and how many improvement ideas a demo gets. Edit the numbers here — validate_spec.py, build_outputs.py and the skill read this file. Bounds: min inclusive, max exclusive. null = no cap.

tiers.label: OOTB — keep it simple
tiers.intent: Show the product as it is. Stock objects, stock pages, stock lookups; a few new fields at most. No custom objects, no designer-built processes, no flow redesign — quick wins only.
tiers.data_volume: Showcase-light: hero records + 5–15 per business object

tiers.label: Medium impact
tiers.intent: Mostly stock, tailored where the customer's story needs it: a couple of custom objects, simple processes, one or two AI moments. Moderate flow improvements.
tiers.data_volume: Showcase: hero records + 10–30 per business object

tiers.label: High impact
tiers.intent: Tailored demo: custom objects where they carry the story, richer automation, several AI moments, simulated integrations, competitive differentiators built in. Suggest flow improvements actively.
tiers.data_volume: Showcase+: hero records + 20–60 per business object

tiers.label: Extremely high impact
tiers.intent: Strategic deal: build what makes the customer's future process visible — custom apps and objects, end-to-end automation, AI agents, several personas, integrations simulated in depth. Re-think the flow, not only polish it; include at least one flow-redesign proposal.
tiers.data_volume: Rich: hero records + 50–200 per business object
